prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1020; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. The patient reports immediate pain and swelling in the right knee at the time of impact, with difficulty bearing weight during the first 24 hours. No loss of consciousness was reported, and no head or spinal complaints were noted at intake.

On examination, there was moderate effusion of the right knee and tenderness along the medial joint line. Range of motion was limited by pain at approximately 70 degrees of flexion. Ligament stability testing was largely reassuring, though pain limited full assessment. Neurovascular status of the right lower extremity was intact.

Imaging was ordered to rule out fracture. Radiographs showed no acute bony abnormality. Working diagnosis is a soft tissue knee injury, likely medial collateral ligament strain with associated contusion.

Treatment consisted of rest, ice, compression, and a prescribed anti-inflammatory medication. Activity restrictions were reviewed. The patient was advised to return for reassessment if symptoms worsen, if weight-bearing becomes impossible, or if numbness or instability develops. A follow-up visit was completed, at which pain and swelling had improved and range of motion had increased to approximately 100 degrees. Prognosis for full recovery is good with conservative management.
